cases.name: compute-aba-routing
cases.description: A mod-10 check digit, from a composed pack
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="packs" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="template" value="usa.finance.aba_routing"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-ordinal-suffix
cases.description: choose picks the right ordinal suffix, including the teens
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="packs" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="template" value="usa.geo.streetName"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-uuid-pack
cases.description: A pack that ships a rule rather than a list
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="packs" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="template" value="common.id.uuid"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-takes-no-draws
cases.description: A computed sequence draws nothing, so it shifts nothing after it
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="nodraw" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="100..999"/></sequence><sequence name="S"><compute><result><to_number><field name="A"/></to_number></result></compute></sequence><sequence name="B"><gen type="number" value="100..999"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}},${{S}},${{B}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-reduce-and-encode
cases.description: reduce over a string, with encode folding letters to numbers
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Code"><gen type="text" value="AB12"/></sequence><sequence name="Sum"><compute><result><reduce><over><field name="Code"/></over><init><int v="0"/></init><do><add><acc/><to_number><encode as="base36"><current/></encode></to_number></add></do></reduce></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Code}}=${{Sum}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-euclidean-mod
cases.description: mod is always non-negative, whatever the host language does
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="M"><compute><result><concat><mod><int v="-7"/><int v="3"/></mod><str v=" "/><mod><int v="7"/><int v="-3"/></mod><str v=" "/><divide><int v="-7"/><int v="3"/></divide></concat></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{M}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-pad-and-slice
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><compute><let name="s"><str v="42"/></let><result><concat><pad width="6"><var name="s"/></pad><str v="|"/><pad width="6" fill="*"><var name="s"/></pad><str v="|"/><length><str v="hello"/></length></concat></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: case-transforms-and-trim
cases.description: <upper>, <lower>, <capitalize>, <title> and <trim>. Every one of them was implemented five times and pinned by no shared case, so four ports were free to disagree about, say, what <title> does to the second word.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="W"><gen type="text" value="  wide open road  "/></sequence><sequence name="T"><compute><result><trim><field name="W"/></trim></result></compute></sequence><sequence name="U"><compute><result><upper><trim><field name="W"/></trim></upper></result></compute></sequence><sequence name="L"><compute><result><lower><str v="LOUD"/></lower></result></compute></sequence><sequence name="C"><compute><result><capitalize><str v="one two"/></capitalize></result></compute></sequence><sequence name="Ti"><compute><result><title><str v="one two"/></title></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{T}}|${{U}}|${{L}}|${{C}}|${{Ti}}</data></line></block></tdc>
expected: wide open road|WIDE OPEN ROAD|loud|One two|One Two

cases.name: string-surgery-mask-replace-slice-group
cases.description: <mask>, <replace>, <slice> — including a negative from= — and <group>. The compute-layer spellings, which are a different code path from the mask= attribute the formatting cases already cover.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Raw"><gen type="text" value="378984323"/></sequence><sequence name="M"><compute><result><mask pattern="xxx-xx-xxxx"><field name="Raw"/></mask></result></compute></sequence><sequence name="R"><compute><result><replace from="-" to="/"><str v="2026-08-03"/></replace></result></compute></sequence><sequence name="S"><compute><result><slice from="2" to="5"><str v="abcdefgh"/></slice></result></compute></sequence><sequence name="S2"><compute><result><slice from="-3"><str v="abcdefgh"/></slice></result></compute></sequence><sequence name="G"><compute><result><group size="4" sep=" "><str v="4111111111111111"/></group></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{M}}|${{R}}|${{S}}|${{S2}}|${{G}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: lists-at-index-and-current-index
cases.description: <join>, <list>, <at> with <in>/<index>, <at default=> out of range, <current_index/> inside a <reduce>, <multiply> and <subtract>. The <current_index/> shape is the one every check-digit algorithm is built on.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="J"><compute><result><join sep="-"><in><list v="10,20,30"/></in></join></result></compute></sequence><sequence name="A"><compute><result><at><in><list v="7,8,9"/></in><index><int v="1"/></index></at></result></compute></sequence><sequence name="Dv"><compute><result><at default="0"><in><list v="7,8,9"/></in><index><int v="9"/></index></at></result></compute></sequence><sequence name="W"><compute><result><reduce><over><list v="5,1,2,0"/></over><init><int v="0"/></init><do><add><acc/><multiply><current/><at><in><list v="1,3,1,3"/></in><index><current_index/></index></at></multiply></add></do></reduce></result></compute></sequence><sequence name="Sub"><compute><result><subtract><int v="17"/><int v="9"/></subtract></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{J}}|${{A}}|${{Dv}}|${{W}}|${{Sub}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: predicates-less-greater-is-digit
cases.description: <less_than>, <greater_than> and <is_digit> inside <choose>/<when>/<test>. A predicate that answers backwards in one port silently picks the other branch — there is no crash to notice.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Lo"><compute><result><choose><when><test><less_than><int v="5"/><int v="30"/></less_than></test><then><str v="low"/></then></when><otherwise><str v="high"/></otherwise></choose></result></compute></sequence><sequence name="Hi"><compute><result><choose><when><test><greater_than><int v="91"/><int v="9"/></greater_than></test><then><str v="big"/></then></when><otherwise><str v="small"/></otherwise></choose></result></compute></sequence><sequence name="Dg"><compute><result><choose><when><test><is_digit><slice from="0" to="1"><str v="7abc"/></slice></is_digit></test><then><str v="numeric"/></then></when><otherwise><str v="letter"/></otherwise></choose></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Lo}}|${{Hi}}|${{Dg}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: every-encoding
cases.description: <encode as=> in all five spellings other than base36: ascii, unicode, hex, octal, binary. The letter A, so the expected values are the same number written five ways.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="E"><compute><result><join sep="|"><list><encode as="ascii"><str v="A"/></encode><encode as="unicode"><str v="A"/></encode><encode as="hex"><str v="A"/></encode><encode as="octal"><str v="A"/></encode><encode as="binary"><str v="A"/></encode></list></join></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{E}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: each-maps-a-list-and-equals-compares
cases.description: <each> over a list with <multiply> in its body, folded by <join>, and <equals> inside a <test>. Both appeared only in diagnostics/ before — their REFUSALS were pinned five ways and their results by nothing. <each> is the map operation the list page is built around, so it is the last one that should have been unpinned.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Doubled"><compute><result><join sep=","><each><over><list v="3,5,8"/></over><do><multiply><current/><int v="2"/></multiply></do></each></join></result></compute></sequence><sequence name="Eq"><compute><result><choose><when><test><equals><int v="7"/><int v="7"/></equals></test><then><str v="same"/></then></when><otherwise><str v="different"/></otherwise></choose></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Doubled}}|${{Eq}}</data></line></block></tdc>
